usedFor: Changecrab keeps changelogs, and “Create a Changelog Post” and “Update Changelog Post” write and edit entries.

bestTemplate.name: “Create a Changelog Post” in Changecrab
bestTemplate.why: It adds a post to a changelog, so a release note lands where the changelog lives.

watchOut: “Delete Changelog Post” and “Delete Changelog” both remove content, so check what a step deletes before it runs.
